label: Greenline E-Drive
info:
Reads the Greenline 6GK electric-drive CANopen TPDOs (nodes 0x0A port / 0x0B starboard) passively from can0 via candump and feeds two virtual E-drive (motordrive) devices.

Decoded map (IEEE-754 LE float pairs):
0x28x: [controller-region temp C, MOTOR TEMP C]
0x38x: [MOTOR VOLTAGE V, PHASE CURRENT RMS A]
0x48x: [MOTOR POWER x100W signed (+ motoring / - generating), MOTOR RPM]

Direction from NMEA2000 PGN 127493 (matched by PGN mask 01F20500:03FFFF00 — any source/priority; instance byte 0=port, 1=stbd), byte 1 bits 0-1: 0=Forward, 1=Neutral, 2=Reverse.

Watchdog pattern from Virtual BMS: pkill stale capture before start, chunk-safe line parser, restart 5s after candump exits.

NOTE: device type is 'motordrive' (not 'e-drive') and node IDs must not contain dots — the palette version bundled with Venus OS (1.6.x) puts the raw node ID in the dbus settings path and only knows the pre-rename device value. 'motordrive' still works on current palette versions (auto-migrates to E-drive when edited).
